# firezone_group (Resource)

A Group - a set of Actors that Policies grant access via. Only unsynced (Terraform-managed) Groups can be created here; Groups synced from an identity provider must be looked up via the firezone_group data source instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only for Groups you want Terraform to own. Groups synced from an
# identity provider are read-only via the API - look those up with the
# firezone_group data source instead.
resource "firezone_group" "contractors" {
  name = "Contractors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.
